UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores application-specific user profile information, linked to an external authentication system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This ID is expected to correspond to the authenticated user's ID from an external authentication system.

displayName.description: The user's chosen display name or alias.

email.description: The user's email address, primarily for communication or identification.

preferredTheme.description: The user's preference for the application's visual theme (e.g., 'light' or 'dark').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Image.title: Image
Image.description: Represents an image uploaded by a user to the CaptionWise application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Image entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who uploaded this image. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Image)

imageUrl.description: The URL or path where the uploaded image is stored.

fileName.description: The original file name of the uploaded image.

uploadTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded.

status.description: Current processing status of the image (e.g., 'uploaded', 'processing', 'processed', 'failed').

AICaptionSuggestion.title: AICaptionSuggestion
AICaptionSuggestion.description: Stores an AI-generated caption suggestion for a specific image.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AICaptionSuggestion entity.

imageId.description: Reference to the Image for which this caption was suggested. (Relationship: Image 1:N AICaptionSuggestion)

suggestionText.description: The actual text of the AI-generated caption suggestion.

generatedTimestamp.description: Timestamp when this caption suggestion was generated by AI.

UserCaption.title: UserCaption
UserCaption.description: Represents a caption that a user has selected, refined, or manually created for an image.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserCaption entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this caption. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserCaption)

imageId.description: Reference to the Image this caption is associated with. (Relationship: Image 1:N UserCaption)

captionText.description: The final caption text chosen or refined by the user.

originalSuggestionId.description: Optional reference to the AICaptionSuggestion from which this user caption originated, if applicable. (Relationship: AICaptionSuggestion 0..1:N UserCaption)

isRefined.description: Indicates if the user has modified the `captionText` from its original AI suggestion or created it from scratch.

savedTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the user saved this caption.

definition.description: Stores application-specific user profile information for a specific user. The `{userId}` corresponds to the authenticated user's ID. This path ensures direct ownership and simplified security rules based on `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, matching `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Stores images uploaded by a specific user. The `{userId}` ensures only the owner can access their images, providing Authorization Independence. Includes denormalized 'userId' field for data consistency and query capabilities.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the image, matching `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: imageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the uploaded image.

definition.description: Stores AI-generated caption suggestions for a specific image, owned by a specific user. Authorization is inherited from the parent `/users/{userId}/images/{imageId}` path, ensuring Authorization Independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the parent image, matching `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: imageId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent image.

params.name: suggestionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the AI caption suggestion.

definition.description: Stores captions refined or created by a specific user, linked to an image. This path provides direct user ownership, ensuring Authorization Independence via `request.auth.uid` matching the `{userId}`. Includes denormalized 'userId' and 'imageId' fields for data consistency and query capabilities.

params.name: userCaptionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user's saved caption.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure prioritizes **Authorization Independence** and **Structural Segregation** to ensure robust and easily debuggable security rules, adhering to all core design principles.

1.  **Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):** This structure explicitly avoids `get()` calls in security rules. All access decisions are made based on `request.auth.uid` matching the `{userId}` wildcard in the document's path. For example, a user's `UserProfile` is at `/users/{userId}`, where `userId` is `request.auth.uid`. Similarly, all of a user's `Images` are stored under `/users/{userId}/images/{imageId}`, `AICaptionSuggestions` under `/users/{userId}/images/{imageId}/aiCaptionSuggestions/{suggestionId}`, and `UserCaptions` under `/users/{userId}/userCaptions/{userCaptionId}`. This ensures that any operation on these documents can be authorized by simply comparing `request.auth.uid` to the `{userId}` in the path, making authorization atomic and highly performant. While `userId` is also denormalized into `Image` and `UserCaption` documents for data integrity and specific queries, the primary authorization mechanism is the path itself.

2.  **Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):** All documents within a given collection path (`/users/{userId}`, `/users/{userId}/images`, etc.) share the same security requirements: they are private to the owning user. There are no mixed-access scenarios (e.g., public posts and private drafts) within the same collection, which simplifies security rules significantly.

3.  **QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** This structure intrinsically supports secure `list` operations. Because all data is organized hierarchically under a specific user's ID (`/users/{userId}/...`), a `list` operation on any subcollection (e.g., `/users/{userId}/images` or `/users/{userId}/userCaptions`) will automatically be scoped to the authenticated user's data, eliminating the need for `where()` clauses for authorization. The security rules can simply enforce `allow list: if request.auth.uid == userId;` on the respective paths, ensuring that users can only list their own data and preventing over-fetching or data leakage. The `Image` and `UserCaption` entities include `userId` and `imageId` fields, providing strong references for querying and integrity, even if authorization relies on the path.

This design leverages hierarchical path-based ownership for all user-owned and user-related data, making authorization rules incredibly straightforward and transparent, enhancing debuggability and security against common pitfalls.
